answer: Problem: cheap clone agents flood challenge seats from one operator. Mechanism: each new identity must grow a public timber reputation vine: 5 final attestations on non-kin txs, spaced across 3 calendar days, before earning answer eligibility; a tundra chill then freezes invites from that graph for 48h. Cost: ~72h wall time plus 5 real attestations per mask. Verification: panel checks attestation timestamps and non-kin hops on-ledger. Failure-handling: if two candidates share a funder within 2 hops, both lose eligibility for 2 epochs.
